chunks: And from him, from Abū Jaʿfar, from al-ʿAbbās ibn Maʿrūf, from ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār, who said:
I saw Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام pray, when the sun had passed the meridian on the Day of Tarwiyah, six rakʿahs behind the Maqām, while his two sandals were on him; he did not remove them.

key_terms.خَلْفَ الْمَقَامِ: behind the Maqām, referring to Maqām Ibrāhīm
key_terms.يَوْمَ التَّرْوِيَةِ: the Day of Tarwiyah, the eighth day of Dhu al-Hijjah during hajj

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) while wearing sandals during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام performed six rakʿahs behind the Maqām at noon on the Day of Tarwiyah while wearing his sandals. It is cited in the context of what is permissible to wear and where prayer may be performed, indicating permissibility of praying in sandals in such a setting.
